speaker: council
text: Contractor. This is the Office of Societal Compliance. You are on a recorded line.

speaker: council
text: Form 7742-C. The garrison at The Outpost is in breach of Section 12, Continued Existence. A notice was displayed on their planet for the statutory thirty days.

speaker: council
text: Their commanding officer declined to sign for it. He has been added to the invoice.

speaker: council
text: You will remove him, and everyone who reports to him. Transport is included one way.

speaker: council
text: A previous contractor was assigned to this account. That file is closed. Please do not ask about the deposit.

speaker: council
text: The door gun is a courtesy. The Council thanks you for your continued compliance.

speaker: radio
text: Two minutes to the wire. Door's yours, contractor. Anything on that compound is billable.

speaker: radio
text: That's armour in the yard. Save your belt, it just bounces.

speaker: radio
text: Missile! Missile! We're hit! Putting her down outside the wire. Brace!

speaker: radio
text: This is as far as the rental goes. Good luck with the paperwork.

speaker: commander
text: Good afternoon. This is the Commander of this outpost. You are firing on a recognised military installation.

speaker: commander
text: A door gun. How traditional. All squads, get under something.

speaker: commander
text: That is a main battle tank. You are not scratching the paint. Do carry on.

speaker: commander
text: There. Now we can talk properly.

speaker: commander
text: You're on my ground now. I've read your file, contractor. You're not the first.

speaker: commander
text: Close the gate.

speaker: commander
text: We don't take deliveries after four.

speaker: commander
text: All stations, this is Command. One hostile, on foot, outside the wire. Send the trucks.

speaker: council
text: Your transport has been marked as damaged. This has been added to your account.

speaker: commander
text: Two trucks on the east road. Light work. Try to keep up with them.

speaker: commander
text: You shot the driver. Good. That's what I'd have done.

speaker: commander
text: Bravo is going round your left. I'm telling you so that you can watch it happen.

speaker: commander
text: Tower Two has you. He'll stop when you stop.

speaker: commander
text: West road. Everything we have with wheels.

speaker: commander
text: Twelve men. I knew nine of them by name.

speaker: council
text: Your progress has been noted. Please retain your receipts.

speaker: commander
text: Enough. All armour, roll out.

speaker: commander
text: That is a tank. I'd like you to look at it. Now look at your little gun.

speaker: commander
text: You're knocking. Nobody's home.

speaker: council
text: Contractor. Our records place a previous contractor's equipment in the south-east corner of the site. Retrieval is at your own risk. It is not covered.

speaker: commander
text: I know where you're going. We buried him. We didn't bury his kit. I have always regretted that.

speaker: commander
text: That one lasted nine days. I kept his boots. They didn't fit.

speaker: commander
text: Ah. Well. That does change the conversation.

speaker: council
text: Item recovered. Its previous owner's balance has been transferred to you.

speaker: commander
text: All units, he has a launcher. Spread out. Do not bunch up.

speaker: commander
text: That was forty tonnes. That was signed out in my name.

speaker: commander
text: Get the bird up. Put it on his head.

speaker: commander
text: Do you know what one of those costs? I do. It's on a form.

speaker: commander
text: Back Bulwark into the gate. Nothing gets past Bulwark.

speaker: commander
text: It's in the gate. The gate won't close. The gate will not close.

speaker: council
text: The Council reminds you that wreckage left in a public gateway may incur a fine.

speaker: commander
text: Seal the citadel! Drop the blast door! Now, now, now!

speaker: commander
text: He went under it. Who taught him that?

speaker: commander
text: You've spent twenty minutes trying to get in here. Let's see how you like it.

speaker: commander
text: Lights.

speaker: commander
text: Every corridor in this block goes round in a circle. My men know that. You don't.

speaker: commander
text: Contact south corridor. Pin him. Second team, through the bunks.

speaker: commander
text: You're still going. I'd hoped you'd be tired. Do you get tired?

speaker: commander
text: The bridge went in the last audit. Nobody signed for the repair. Do enjoy the view.

speaker: council
text: Your movement suite includes a lateral burst. This is not a recommendation. It is a reminder that you were billed for it.

speaker: commander
text: Nobody comes down here. I had the walkway taken out. There is no way across.

speaker: council
text: Your boots are rated for vertical surfaces. The Council accepts no liability for walls.

speaker: commander
text: That was a wall. You ran on the wall. What are you?

speaker: commander
text: Everybody hold your fire. Let him come in. Let him sit down.

speaker: commander
text: Now.

speaker: commander
text: They were eating in here yesterday.

speaker: commander
text: That's my armoury. Those are signed for. Put those back.

speaker: council
text: Ordnance recovered on site is not deducted from your fee. Take what you can carry.

speaker: commander
text: Second Platoon. Full plate. Walk, do not run. Let him empty that thing into your chests.

speaker: commander
text: Those plates cost more than you do.

speaker: commander
text: Second Platoon? Second Platoon, report. Anybody.

speaker: commander
text: You're in the Stack. There is nothing above you but me.

speaker: commander
text: Every man on every landing. Anyone who leaves his post, I'll shoot myself. I mean I'll shoot him. I mean, you know what I mean.

speaker: commander
text: Fourteen months. I had fourteen months left. Do you know what a pension is?

speaker: commander
text: Right. I've had this sent up from stores. Stay exactly where you are.

speaker: commander
text: Look at it. Look what you did to my yard.

speaker: council
text: Contractor. Please conclude. You are approaching your billable hours.

speaker: council
text: Notice of Completion. Form 7742-C is discharged. The Outpost has been removed from the register.

speaker: council
text: Your fee has been calculated. Deductions: one helicopter, one gate, one previous contractor. Balance: see reverse.

speaker: radio
text: Contractor, this is Packmule 2-3. The Council says you can walk.

speaker: council
text: The Commander's service record has been retained. Deceased personnel remain eligible to serve at the Kill House.

speaker: council
text: Replacement contractor issued. The fee has been deducted.

speaker: commander
text: You again. Or another one of you. Does it matter?

speaker: council
text: Your replacement has been briefed. Please try to keep this one.

speaker: commander
text: We've done this part. I've told the men where you'll be.
